title: Runbook
description: A runbook the daemon can start, as its host lists it: a script of the stub runtime, a runbook of the runbook home (runbook serve --runbook-home, runtime loom) or a runbook of --runbook-dir. The daemon reads the list from the host when a client asks for the view Runbooks; the language cannot read a file system, so no command of the specification creates or changes a row, and a client reads the list only.

runbook_version.description: The version the runtime has for the runbook (for the runbook home, the revision of its root protocol); absent when the host names none.

sdc.daemon.RunbookName.title: RunbookName
sdc.daemon.RunbookName.description: The name of a runbook in the list the view Runbooks gives: the text a client puts into the runbook_id of a SubmitRun. A type of its own, not RunbookId, because a row of that list names a runbook the daemon can start and is not a reference of a run to it.

sdc.daemon.RunbookVersion.title: RunbookVersion
sdc.daemon.RunbookVersion.description: The version of a runbook, as runbook list shows it. Optional in a submit: absent means the version the daemon has.

sdc.daemon.RuntimeKind.title: RuntimeKind
sdc.daemon.RuntimeKind.description: The runtime that runs the daemon's runs (runbook serve --runtime): stub is scripted and executes nothing; loom runs the runbook through Loom's library entry in the daemon's process.
